issues: Landing page still contains a 'TFCS Mainframe' promo block (LandingPage.jsx line ~338-358 with heading 'TFCS Mainframe' and a Cpu icon). action_items: Optional (out of strict scope but consistent with problem statement): rename 'TFCS Mainframe' block in LandingPage.jsx (lines ~339-358) to remove legacy TFCS terminology from marketing surface. Heading is 'TFCS Mainframe' with a 'Learn More' CTA.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/workspace.py get_workspace_context: catch-all `except Exception -> HTTPException(500, str(e))` leaks internal error text to clients. Consider returning a generic message and logging the details.

backend/routes/workspace.py get_workspace_context: 'Final fallback' at line 230 grants has_access=true to ANY user with a valid JWT even without an org/tfcs role/platform_admin membership, redirecting them to /app/dashboard. This is intentional for onboarding but effectively means the endpoint never returns has_access=false for authenticated users. Ensure downstream code (AppLayout hasWorkspaceAccess) does not accidentally treat these users as owners.

backend/routes/workspace.py verify_jwt_token: uses jwt.decode(..., options={'verify_signature': False}) - NO signature verification. Any well-formed JWT with a 'sub' claim is accepted. Anyone can forge a JWT and impersonate any user_id. This is a CRITICAL SECURITY BUG that should be fixed by verifying against Supabase JWT secret or calling /auth/v1/user with the token. Confirmed via test_invalid_token: only failed because token wasn't valid JWT format. If attacker crafts {'sub':'<real-user-uuid>'} and signs with any key, endpoint accepts it and returns that user's context. HIGH PRIORITY.
frontend DashboardRedirect.jsx: silently falls back to /app/dashboard if /api/workspace/context returns non-200. If backend has an outage, users bypass Command Center. Consider a visible error state.

frontend AppLayout.jsx: hasWorkspaceAccess relies on workspaceContext.has_access which per backend fallback is ALWAYS true for authenticated users -> every logged-in user gets the TradeOS sidebar (dark theme) regardless of org membership. If intent was 'only org members get TradeOS nav', tighten the check to workspaceContext.has_organization || workspaceContext.is_platform_admin.
frontend LandingPage.jsx line 345: 'TFCS Mainframe' heading is legacy terminology that contradicts the spec intent to drop TFCS branding.
